note: A rendering correction for RCEF's face examples: maps an ARKit weight as ICT-FaceKit renders it to the Rocketbox Female weight that moves her face about as much. It calibrates how two example rigs render ARKit names, not any tracker; it is not a provider claim and not pack data. Shapes under not_normalised failed their held-out evaluation and are left unchanged.
